field.label: Success path
field.comment: Path on your frontend to redirect to after a successful payment, e.g. checkout/success. Guest orders get a token query parameter to load the order with guestOrderByToken. Leave empty to use the default Magento success page.

field.label: Cancel path
field.comment: Path on your frontend to redirect to when the payment is cancelled or fails. Leave empty to use the default bol.checkout error page.
